parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the structural similarity is high (Jaccard 0.78), the two methods — `calculatesAvgShaderFPS` (line 319) and `recordsInterpolatorResets` (line 461) — test distinct behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` (shader FPS averaging vs. interpolator reset recording). Near-duplicate shape in test methods is common when tests follow a shared arrange-act-assert scaffold; collapsing them would obscure the distinct intent of each test case and reduce diagnostic clarity on failure.
